\runinhead{Limitations and Future Work.} Despite promising results, KG-NAS has several limitations:
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Category-Specific Optimization}: Current framework uses uniform search strategy across all categories. Category-adaptive search could further improve performance.
    \item \textbf{Alignment Failures}: Dynamic alignment occasionally degrades performance (e.g., metal\_nut). Investigating failure cases could lead to more robust alignment strategies.
    \item \textbf{Cross-Dataset Detection Paradigm}: The reverse-distillation paradigm is evaluated on MVTec-AD; extending it to VisA and BTAD (currently using the prototype paradigm) would unify the framework across benchmarks.
    \item \textbf{Paradigm Selection}: Automatic per-category selection between the reverse-distillation and prototype paradigms (Section~\ref{subsec:paradigm_complementarity}) remains an open direction for further accuracy gains.
\end{itemize}
patches.replace: \runinhead{Limitations.} Two further failure modes are worth recording: dynamic alignment occasionally degrades a category (e.g.\ metal\_nut), and the reverse-distillation paradigm is validated only on MVTec-AD while VisA and BTAD currently use the prototype paradigm. The consolidated list of limitations, including the measured capacity envelope, is given in Section~\ref{sec:conclusion}.
